name: Aluwind Infra-Tech Ltd.
summary: Aluwind Infra-Tech Limited specializes in the design, fabrication, and installation of high-quality aluminum architectural products, primarily focusing on aluminum windows and glass facade solutions. The company's product portfolio includes aluminum windows, doors, curtain walls, cladding, and various glazing systems such as structural glazing, unitized glazing, and spider glazing, along with aluminum composite panels, skylights, and canopies. Aluwind Infra-Tech serves architects, consultants, builders, institutions, and corporates for large-scale B2B residential and commercial building projects across India. The company operates within the architectural services, construction, and infrastructure sectors. Additionally, it has a subsidiary, Aluwind Clean-Tech Private Limited, providing facade cleaning and maintenance services, and is engaged in the research and development of Solar Facades, specifically Building-Integrated Photovoltaic panels. The company also holds an anchor partnership with Eternia-Hindalco for manufacturing window orders.
